about_the_game:
1999 - HAVENBROOK, UNITED STATES.

While investigating the disappearance of Isabelle Nox, journalist Janet Sheperd returns to Havenbrook, the town she once called home.

Hidden deep within the surrounding forest stands an abandoned institutional building, long sealed and officially erased from local records. Years ago, a reclusive cult occupied the structure, preaching that the forest could grant rebirth and absolution. Then, without warning, they vanished.

Janet enters the decaying complex to document what remains.

Inside, the world outside ceases to exist.

What she finds are fragments: old journals, distorted recordings, faded documents hinting at something the cult called "the return of the Savior." But as Janet explores the crumbling corridors, time begins to fracture. Rooms shift. Hallways repeat. Events loop. The deeper she goes, the more the building seems to remember.

And so does she.

The structure begins to mirror her past. Corridors become hallways from her childhood. Objects from her family home appear where they don't belong. The line between the investigation and something far more personal begins to blur.

To uncover what happened to Isabelle Nox, Janet must piece together the truth, not just about the cult, but about the night she lost her best friend. The night her mind chose to forget.

Some places are abandoned.

Others are waiting.
detailed_description:
Feature List

  • Truth is not written. It is trapped, relive the same moments again and again. Each loop brings you closer to what really happened.

  • Uncover what happened through fragments of the past that resurface when reality breaks, an intimate, haunting story told through silence, memory, and the spaces in between.

  • A multi-layered narrative thriller, blending mystery, psychological horror, and temporal dislocation.

  • You are not alone, Something remains in the shadows. Not a single pursuer, but fractured human shapes that surface when you least expect them.


Just Updated

At the moment, we are working on full support for the Xbox Controller, which will be available in the final version of Shadows of Deceit.

name: Shadows Of Deceit

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)/Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, Intel Core i7-4770K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: AMD Radeon RX 470 (4 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT (4 GB), NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (4 GB), NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB)
  • Additional Notes: Estimated Performance (Setting Performance Priority): 1080p/45 fps. Frame rate drops may occur during more complex scenes.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)/Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Sound Card: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB), AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (8 GB), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8 GB)
  • Additional Notes: Estimated Performance (Setting Performance Priority): 1080p/45 fps. Frame rate drops may occur during more complex scenes.

short_description: Shadows of Deceit is a first-person psychological horror focused on narrative investigation and atmosphere. Set within an abandoned building deep in Havenbrook forest, the player uncovers fragments of the past and reconstructs the truth about the night Isabelle Nox disappeared.
